question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 36√3 cm. Find its height.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of an equilateral triangle = Perimeter ÷ 3

Side = 36√3 ÷ 3 = 12√3 cm

Height = (√3 ÷ 2) × Side

Height = (√3 ÷ 2) × 12√3 = 6 × 3 = 18 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

The area can be calculated directly if the side length (a) is known: Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a².

Inradius (r)

The radius of the inscribed circle is exactly one-third of the triangle's height: r = a ÷ 2√3.

Circumradius (R)

The radius of the circumscribed circle is exactly two-thirds of the triangle's height: R = a ÷ √3.
